description: The bar chart illustrates the average JGA (Joint Goal Accuracy) scores across different turn IDs for two models — an unnamed model represented by orange bars and T5-small represented by yellow bars — as evaluated in the context of continual dialogue state tracking, likely from the paper “Continual Dialogue State Tracking via Reason-of-Select Distillation.” The horizontal axis, labeled “Turn ID,” ranges from 0 to 26 in increments of 2, representing sequential dialogue turns. The vertical axis, labeled “Avg. JGA Score,” spans from 0.2 to 1.0 in increments of 0.1, indicating the performance metric. For each Turn ID, two adjacent bars show the respective model scores, with the orange bar consistently outperforming the yellow T5-small bar across all turns. The highest scores occur at Turn ID 0, where both models achieve near-perfect performance (orange ≈ 0.95, yellow ≈ 0.94), and performance generally declines as Turn ID increases, with the most notable drop occurring after Turn ID 20. The legend in the upper right corner identifies the orange bar as the primary model (unlabeled in the legend but implied by context) and the yellow bar as T5-small. No error bars or statistical annotations are present, and the bars are not sorted by value — they are ordered chronologically by Turn ID. The chart visually emphasizes the performance gap between the two models, particularly in later turns, where the orange model maintains higher accuracy than T5-small.
